description_en: Queries sold instances and their quotas and properties by paging based on resource type, instance ID, business resource ID, and status
description_zh: 按资源类型、实例 ID、业务资源 ID 和状态分页查询售卖实例及其额度和属性
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.help_en: The resource type. For example, CorePackage indicates a core-hour package. It must be consistent with the resource type of the target instance
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，例如 CorePackage 表示核时包。需与目标实例的资源类型一致
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of sold instance IDs, which is used to specify the instances for this operation
parameters.help_zh: 售卖实例 ID 列表，用于指定本次操作的实例
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of associated business resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 关联的业务资源 ID 列表
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of instance statuses used for filtering. You can use NORMAL, DELETED, PENDING, and EXPIRED. ARCHIVED indicates the historical archived status
parameters.help_zh: 实例状态筛选列表。可使用 NORMAL、DELETED、PENDING、EXPIRED；ARCHIVED 为历史归档状态
parameters.name: state_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only instances that are not associated with a business resource ID. Valid values:
true: Queries only unassociated instances.
false or empty: Does not filter by this condition
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅查询尚未关联业务资源 ID 的实例。true：仅查询未关联实例；false 或不填：不按该条件筛选
parameters.name: no_resource_id

parameters.help_en: The list of instance property names to be filtered
parameters.help_zh: 需要筛选的实例属性名称列表
parameters.name: property_key_list

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Leave it empty for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass the NextToken value returned in the previous response as is. Do not construct or decode it yourself
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询标记。首次查询不填；继续查询时原样传入上一次响应的 NextToken，不要自行构造或解码
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return per query
parameters.help_zh: 每次查询返回的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

Instances.description_en: The list of sold instances that meet the query conditions
Instances.description_zh: 符合查询条件的售卖实例列表

items.description_en: The list of sold instances that meet the query conditions
items.description_zh: 符合查询条件的售卖实例列表

AliUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the resource belongs
AliUid.description_zh: 资源所属的阿里云账号 ID

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 到期时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

InstanceId.description_en: The sold instance ID, which is used to identify the purchased instance
InstanceId.description_zh: 售卖实例 ID，用于标识购买的实例

PropertyList.description_en: The list of instance properties. Each item contains the property name Key and the property value Value
PropertyList.description_zh: 实例属性列表，每项包含属性名称 Key 和属性值 Value

items.description_en: The list of instance properties. Each item contains the property name Key and the property value Value
items.description_zh: 实例属性列表，每项包含属性名称 Key 和属性值 Value

Value.description_en: The instance property value, which corresponds to the Key in the same entry
Value.description_zh: 实例属性值，与同一条目中的 Key 对应

ResourceId.description_en: The associated business resource ID, which is used to distinguish from the sold instance ID
ResourceId.description_zh: 关联的业务资源 ID，与售卖实例 ID 区分使用

ResourceType.description_en: The resource type. For example, CorePackage indicates a core-hour package. It must be consistent with the resource type of the target instance
ResourceType.description_zh: 资源类型，例如 CorePackage 表示核时包。需与目标实例的资源类型一致

StartTime.description_en: The effective time in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
StartTime.description_zh: 生效时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

State.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
NORMAL: Normal.
DELETED: Deleted.
PENDING: Pending activation.
EXPIRED: Expired.
ARCHIVED: Historical archived status
State.description_zh: 实例状态。NORMAL：正常；DELETED：已删除；PENDING：待激活；EXPIRED：已过期；ARCHIVED：历史归档状态

TotalTime.description_en: The total metering quota included in the instance, using the same unit as UsedTime. A CorePackage core-hour package is metered in core-seconds. For example, 360000 indicates 100 core-hours
TotalTime.description_zh: 实例包含的计量总额度，与 UsedTime 使用相同单位。CorePackage 核时包以核秒计量，例如 360000 表示 100 核时

UsedTime.description_en: The consumed metering quota of the instance. For a CorePackage core-hour package, the unit is core-seconds. Divide by 3600 to convert to core-hours. For other resource types, read according to the corresponding metering criteria
UsedTime.description_zh: 实例已消耗的计量额度。CorePackage 核时包的单位为核秒，除以 3600 可换算为核时。其他资源类型应按对应计量口径读取

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records to return per query
MaxResults.description_zh: 每次查询返回的最大记录数

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token. Leave it empty for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass the NextToken value returned in the previous response as is. Do not construct or decode it yourself
NextToken.description_zh: 分页查询标记。首次查询不填；继续查询时原样传入上一次响应的 NextToken，不要自行构造或解码

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot call issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位调用问题
